 Paddy Power bonus code YEPAAG: 60/1 Chelsea vs Man Utd 1+ Goals Scored
 Luke Seychell 
 Updated on: 31 October 2026 11:02 AM 
 Football , News 
 Use Paddy Power bonus code YEPAAG when signing up ahead of Chelsea vs Man Utd and you’ll get 60/1 for 1 or more goals to be scored in the Premier League match.
 How to claim Paddy Power’s Chelsea vs Man United offer using YEPAAG 
 Click here , or on the banner below, and you’ll be taken directly to Paddy Power’s betting offer.
 Once you have read the T&Cs of the offer and are happy with them, tap the Blue Bet Here button to get to their main site.
 Select Sign Up to register a new account. When creating the account, you need to create a memorable username as well as a strong and secure password.
 During the registration process, you will be asked for a Paddy Power bonus code. Make sure you use YEPAAG to ensure you’re eligible for the offer.
 Once you are signed up, deposit a minimum of £5 by Pay by Bank, Debit Cards or Apple Pay.
 Then head over to Chelsea vs Man Utd on Paddy Power and find the goals market.
 Once here, place a max £1 bet on “Over 0.5 goals” in the over/under goals market at the normal odds.
 If your bet is successful, you will be paid in cash based on the normal price on site and will have the extra amount, bringing the bet up to the cumulative 60/1 payout, credited in free bet builders.
 New customer offer. Place a max £1 bet on “Over 0.5 Goals” in the Over/Under Goals market in Chelsea vs Man United on Saturday 31st October. Winnings paid in cash at normal odds and are topped up to the enhanced price in Free bet builder Bets. Free bet builder bets are valid 14 days, only deposits with cards & ApplePay are eligible.  Chelsea vs Man Utd preview (Saturday 12:30pm)
 Chelsea host Manchester United at Stamford Bridge on Saturday lunchtime, with both sides coming off poor results and neither defence in great shape. 
 Chelsea lost 2-0 at home to Tottenham last weekend and went out of the Carabao Cup on penalties at Anfield, while United were beaten 3-0 by Bournemouth at Old Trafford, with Michael Carrick under pressure.
 Both teams have been leaking goals. Chelsea have conceded 15 in the league, with only Crystal Palace and Ipswich letting in more, and Xabi Alonso is short of defenders, with Reece James out and Maxence Lacroix almost certain to miss out. 
 United have shipped 13 and haven’t won away from home all season. Chelsea’s league games have still produced 32 goals in eight matches, an average of four per game, including a 6-3 win over Leeds. United’s attack has been much quieter, but captain Bruno Fernandes is expected to return, and Kobbie Mainoo is back in contention.
 The history also leans towards goals being scored. The last two meetings produced goals, while goalless draws are rare in the Premier League. With two struggling defences, it’s hard to see this fixture finishing without a goal. That makes the 60/1 offer on over 0.5 goals a standout price. 
 Chelsea vs Manchester United betting odds
 Chelsea head into the match with Man Utd as favourites, which gives a clear indication as to the depths of Man Utd’s problems.
